data.title: Computers and Desk Gadgets
data.summary: Realistic laptops, desktops, monitors, keyboards, phones, audio and desk gadgets: 55 queryable designs for laptop, computer, desk setup, smartphone, headphones and keyboard searches.
data.description: A modern realistic kit of computers and desk gadgets for office, studio and gaming setups: open, closed, gaming and convertible laptops, compact to full desktop towers, an all in one, flat, 4K, curved, superwide and portrait monitors plus a wallmount panel, full-size to split keyboards, wired to vertical mice, tablets, a stylus, smartphones, a fold phone, an e-reader, headphones, earbuds, speakers, a condenser mic, webcams, desks, a sit-stand frame, a stock shelf, monitor arms, stands, risers, lamps, docks, chargers, a coiled cable, a power strip, external drives, a USB hub, a laser printer and device stands. The starter scene is a dressed studio with three desk workstations and a stocked shelf. Every file is self-contained CC0 geometry with no brand logos or badges and no collision or navigation data.
